title: software-factory review output
description: What the review stage returns: its document, plus every finding it raised.

document.description: The stage's whole output, as markdown. Its first line is one sentence summarising the outcome.

findings.description: Every finding this turn raised. Empty when the turn found nothing to raise.

id.description: A short, stable slug for this exact defect, e.g. "work/control.go-missing-nil-check". Reuse the identical string across turns for the same underlying issue; a new issue gets a new id.

blocking.description: True if this finding must be addressed before the work is acceptable.

summary.description: What the finding is, concretely: the evidence checked and the concrete failure it would cause.
